peers.name: Apple Inc.
peers.rationale: Large-scale diversified technology platform with hardware, software, and services; overlaps in ecosystem/cloud/productivity but different revenue mix skewed to devices.

peers.name: Alphabet Inc.
peers.rationale: Direct competitor in cloud infrastructure (Azure vs GCP), productivity/AI tools, and enterprise software; differs in ad-driven core revenue base.

peers.name: AMAZON COM INC
peers.rationale: AWS competes directly with Azure in cloud infrastructure; broader business includes retail, which dilutes comparability outside cloud segment.

peers.name: ORACLE CORP
peers.rationale: Enterprise software and cloud infrastructure competitor with overlapping database, ERP, and cloud services offerings to similar corporate customers.

peers.name: Salesforce, Inc.
peers.rationale: Pure-play enterprise SaaS company competing with Microsoft's business applications and productivity software lines like Dynamics 365.

peers.name: ADOBE INC.
peers.rationale: Subscription-based software company with strong creative and document cloud products; comparable margin structure and SaaS transition economics.

peers.name: SAP SE
peers.rationale: Global enterprise software and ERP leader competing with Microsoft Dynamics and cloud offerings; similar large-enterprise customer base.

peers.name: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP
peers.rationale: Enterprise software, cloud, and AI services competitor with overlapping hybrid cloud and consulting offerings, though weighted more to legacy hardware/services.
